description: Galatone publishes counts of road-code violation reports issued in 2016, ordered by month. CSV and spreadsheet exports describe the same annual table. The description does not identify offence classes, vehicles, streets, crash counts or actual monthly totals. A companion location view has a road-code report title and fields labelled total reports and location of issue, but its short description says locations of crashes in 2016. The conflict remains explicit: these fields are not presented as crash counts. The two source views share Galatone, 2016 and report labels; equal events and disjoint totals are not established. Coverage is Galatone, Puglia, Italy. The licence declared by native metadata is CC-BY-4.0. The public catalogue provides descriptive metadata and the listed distribution links. Costs, access conditions for later file use and present completeness remain unknown. The supplied facts come from source descriptions and distribution labels; data values and file contents were not inspected. No specific simulation method is documented. Related resources may overlap this inventory or time period, but no further exact relationship is established by the inspected metadata.
